Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='DWT_rf', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: DWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) matching y_true's directional shifts, while rf captures seasonality best (0.7401 correlation). ONLY_CWT_rf leads overall RMSE (40.57) but rankings are unstable (Kendall τ=0.2865) with extreme model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=22.95). The trend/seasonality split between champions plus high seasonality variance makes STL-hierarchical stacking ideal for exploiting decomposition-aware combinations.
